## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and motivation. If it fixes an open issue, link it here: `Fixes #...`.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Improvement to metadata resolution or identification accuracy
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Packaging / CI improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] Zero Qt / PySide6 imports in `src/papernym/core/`.
- [ ] Added tests in `tests/` covering new logic or bug fixes.
- [ ] All tests pass: `pytest -q`.
- [ ] Ruff checks pass: `ruff check src tests scripts` and `ruff format --check src tests scripts`.
- [ ] Updated `docs/PROGRESS.md` work log.
